title: Character sum on a perpendicular subspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be orthogonal to every vector in $H$ under the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$. Then the sum over $h\in H$ of the Walsh character $(-1)^{\langle h,x\rangle}$ is $|H|$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is orthogonal to $H$ under the standard dot product
